overview.title: Welcome to Dakhla — lagoon, wind and the edge of the desert
overview.p1: Dakhla sits on a long peninsula in southern Morocco, between a vast turquoise lagoon and the open Atlantic Ocean. Trade winds, shallow waters, and empty shores have made it one of Africa's leading destinations for kitesurfing.
overview.p2: Beyond the water: the White Dune rising from the lagoon, Dragon Island's rocky silhouette, oyster farms, Foum El Bouir on the ocean side, and desert tracks toward Sebkha Imlili. Life in town is calm and revolves around the wind and the horizon.
overview.p3: A 3 to 7-day stay is ideal to combine water sports, a sand dune excursion, and relaxing evenings by the lagoon.

itinerary.subtitle: Wind and lagoon first, then dunes and the ocean side.

detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Walk along the shore, check wind directions, and plan tomorrow's session.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Peaceful light over the lagoon and a simple dinner.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Kitesurfing or wingfoiling on the calm waters of the lagoon.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: More water time or relaxing at a shore-side café.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: An evening by the lagoon or along the waterfront.
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Drive or take a boat toward the White Dune to enjoy the views.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Spot the rocky formation, take photos, and enjoy the lagoon light.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Taste lagoon oysters if in season.
detailed_itinerary.day4_m: Morning — Foum El Bouir or Sebkha Imlili
detailed_itinerary.day4_md: Ocean waves on the far side or a track on the edge of the desert.
detailed_itinerary.day4_a: Afternoon — Free Time or Second Session
detailed_itinerary.day4_ad: Head back to the lagoon for wind or relax before departure.
detailed_itinerary.day4_ed: Final sunset if flight schedules allow.

q1.question: How many days are appropriate in Dakhla?
q1.answer: Three days cover exploring the lagoon along with a sports or dune day. An intensive kitesurfing trip requires 5 to 7 days.

q2.question: Is Dakhla only for kitesurfing?
q2.answer: Wind sports are the main attraction, but the lagoon, White Dune, and oyster tasting also appeal greatly to non-participants.

q3.question: How do I get to Dakhla?
q3.answer: By plane via Dakhla Airport (VIL). Regular domestic flights connect from Casablanca; traveling by road is a very long journey.

q4.question: What is the best time to visit?
q4.answer: Wind is available almost year-round. The period from October to June is very popular due to comfortable temperatures.
